rationale.consistency: Follows v6 shape (ResponseError, CheckResponse, idempotency key) but mixes import groups, drops the nolint:gosec on GetMaxPossibleVUs, and CreateOrFindLoadTest ignores its named err in favour of execErr unlike sibling methods.
rationale.edge_cases: 409 fallback, missing upload URL, aborted/completed-before-start, ctx cancel in poll and retry loops are handled; unknown errors are notified as code 0 rather than null, and an unparsable testRunID silently notifies run 0.
rationale.scope: Covers the required flow, but adds unused Client.apiClient/timeout fields, undocumented MetricsRuntimeConfig/SecretsRuntimeConfig aliases, and a redundant config.MetricsPushURL fallback inside expv2 alongside SetMetricsURL.
rationale.readability: Functions are short and named clearly; the wire struct duplicating StartLocalExecutionRequest, the BaseURL type-assertion hack in newMetricsClient, and repeated host/stackID resolution add noise.
rationale.robustness: Retry replays bodies, stops on 4xx, honours ctx; but the metrics pusher defaults to http.DefaultClient with no timeout, notify uses a bare context.Background, and 5xx are retried even on non-idempotent notify without the idempotency header.
rationale.maintainability: Hidden coupling via versionedOutput.(*cloudv2.Output) assertion, two provisioning clients built from duplicated config logic in cmd and output, dead struct fields, and per-call HTTPClient construction make extension awkward.
